title: Expose the checked continuous stance-design decision to agents
description: Give an agent an immediately useful physical body-design operation from Astra §18.7. Accept load, stance and actuator parameters, return sized width or feasibility, a realizable corner force allocation, policy assumptions and an exclusion witness. Keep the analytic model separately identified from G1 contact simulation.
acceptance_criteria: Change width or policy class through the public interface; reproduce the 3/14 and 1/2 m boundaries, inspect the four forces and reject impossible configurable loads. Test independent equilibrium and limits.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: TODO: derive the continuous family with a variable load and actuator cap; distinguish editable half-width from minimum; compute constrained 2x2 force witnesses; cover equality and zero-offset degeneracies; test against an independent inequality feasibility solver before closing.

title: Run a real FrankenSim G1 episode from a clean studio checkout
description: First implementation slice from the base §37 and Astra W01/W07. Resolve an actual versioned owner interface, run its canonical G1 plant, expose bounded movement and scene parameters, and return physical telemetry and terminal outcomes. Verify repeat and intervention on a clean checkout. Preserve plan-only milestones as open until their full acceptance criteria land.
acceptance_criteria: A documented command executes real owner dynamics with caller-selected settings; the canonical two-second request returns measured samples or an explicit earlier termination; repeat and scene/controller changes are tested.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: TODO: pin published WASM plus glue and license; compare schema/commit and original digests; expose fixed-step G1 on flat and terrain+push; support typed oriented obstacles and sparse changes to owner policy; publish per-run step count, all termination causes, sampled pelvis/contact telemetry, and owner penetration semantics; replay both a near and an irrelevant obstacle.

title: Give CLI and MCP clients the same simulation and design operations
description: Expose one bounded JSON service over a command and standard MCP stdio. Publish schemas, use stable error handling, validate realistic physical inputs, provide examples and rerun from a fresh checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Independent clients discover and call both tools. CLI and MCP give the same result for matched input. Invalid input cannot consume an episode, concatenated tool calls retain their IDs, and the setup works outside the development directory.

comments.author: jemanuel
